printable_v1: Print cleanup starts from touch authority.
Normal and selected-address building heights use the project-normalized default height to avoid block-to-block spikes.
Corner/hole polishing is tiny and must pass covered-area preservation gates.
The output exports GLB for review and STL for slicer inspection.
Visible road, water, and green-space masks are exported as thin raised context layers using the documented narrowed widths.
source_authority: All OSM building footprints clipped to the project rectangle are preserved as source records.
Edge-clipped buildings are explicitly marked and must be cut cleanly at the rectangle boundary.
Landmarks and large/high buildings are protected before any consolidation.
touch_authority: Only normal footprints that touch or overlap are dissolved.
Street and courtyard gaps are not bridged by scale-dependent buffering.
Tiny isolated fragments are marked as optional print-risk details instead of disappearing silently.
